\\ Solid Edge holes.txt file.
\\ The contents of this file populate lists on the options dialog of the Hole command.
\\ The drill diameter is the hole size in your part if you apply a thread treatment.

\\ The contents of this file populate lists on the options dialog of the Thread command.

\\ This file must be located in the Solid Edge program directory.
\\ For example: c:\Program Files\Solid Edge\Program\holes.txt

\\ You can add sizes to the table by following the format:
\\ For threads...
\\ nominal diameter; internal minor diameter; external minor diameter; thread type
\\ for a non tapped hole...
\\ nominal diameter;
\\ Diameters are values and thread type is a string.
\\ The delimiter is a semi colon. 
\\ White spaces are ignored.
\\ You can also delete sizes from the list.

\\ If you edit the list you should copy the file before uninstalling Solid Edge.
